# Ammunition consumption

Used in [Ammunition and stores](/rules/logistics/20-ammunition-and-stores).

## Table

| Mode | Action | Ammo | Applies to |
|---|---|---|---|
| played | barrage | 4 |  |
| played | anti armour | 3 |  |

## Notes

- Printed on common chart page 13 (jp2 p107) as the 'Ammunition Consumption Rates Table'; the rules text (50.2) calls it a Chart.
- 'played' rows cost Ammunition Points per TOE Strength Point performing the action; 'abstracted' rows cost Ammunition Points per unit (battalion-equivalent) when the Logistics Game is abstracted, per the chart's own key.
- The played row 'Engage in air-to-air combat and/or strafe' prints 'TacAir Bombload' stacked in the Ammo column rather than a number; recorded as 'tacair-bombload' (the plane's tacair rating and/or bombload, as the mission uses them). The Air Game rules decide which applies.
- The abstracted rows print assault at 1 for both phasing and non-phasing battalion-equivalents; SPI 32.2 (restated in rules/95-abstract-logistics-and-air.md) has the phasing unit pay double. The chart is transcribed as printed; the abstracted half is not used by the Logistics Game.
- Cross-read: all 14 Ammo cells and row labels against the Discord 'Shared Charts.pdf' page 13 (a separate, sharper scan of the same sheet); no disagreements.
